## Yakusuru 1.1.2, a proper Mac app

On macOS, dragging Yakusuru.app into your Applications folder made it quit the moment you opened it. The app was quietly depending on the folder it came in.

### What's fixed

- **Yakusuru.app now works from anywhere.** The Mac app in this download is self-contained, so you can drag it to Applications, keep it in the Dock, or leave it where it is, like any other Mac app.
- **Copies that lose their folder find their way back.** If you run the app straight from a cloned or synced Yakusuru folder and drag a copy elsewhere, it remembers where its folder is, or asks Spotlight to find it.
- **No more silent quits.** If Yakusuru really can't find its files, it now says so plainly and offers a link to this downloads page.

Nothing changes on Windows or Linux in this release.

### Upgrading on a Mac

1. If you already put an older Yakusuru.app in Applications, move it to the Trash.
2. Download **Yakusuru-v1.1.2.zip** below and unzip it.
3. Drag `macOS/Yakusuru.app` into Applications and open it. The first time, right-click it, choose **Open**, then **Open** again.

Your settings, glossary, API keys and downloaded models are kept.
